title: Literacy by sex
description: Compare effective literacy rates for males and females and inspect the percentage-point gap. Useful for a gender literacy gap project.
geography: States and union territories using 2011 geography
sourceLabel: Census of India 2011 — Provisional Population Totals
caveat: Historical Census boundaries are retained: Andhra Pradesh includes Telangana, Jammu and Kashmir is undivided, and the values should not be presented as current rates.

title: Total & child sex ratio
description: Compare total sex ratio with child sex ratio (age 0–6), including rural and urban differences.
geography: States and union territories using 2011 geography
sourceLabel: MoSPI — Women and Men in India, Chapter 1 tables
caveat: These are 2011 Census measures, not current estimates. Child sex ratio is for ages 0–6. State/UT boundaries use the 2011 vintage.

title: Urban population trend
description: Track how the urban share of population changed from 1991 to 2011.
geography: States and union territories using published historical geography
unit: Percent of total population; change in percentage points
caveat: Use as a historical trend, not a current urbanisation estimate. Census boundaries and state names differ from today.

title: Monthly rainfall — selected states and UTs
description: Explore the seasonality of rainfall using the monthly state/UT totals in the IMD 2023 publication.
geography: 13 selected states/UTs from the published table
sourceLabel: India Meteorological Department — Rainfall Statistics of India 2023
caveat: Selected units only: this is not a full all-India table. Annual total is calculated by summing the 12 displayed monthly values and can differ slightly from officially rounded annual summary values.

title: All-India monthly and annual rainfall
description: Compare monthly rainfall distribution and annual totals over five years, then use the linked long-run source for a longer time-series project.
sourceLabel: MoSPI — EnviStats India 2024, Table 1.08 Annual and Monthly Rainfall (source: IMD)

extraSources.label: Long-run IMD subdivision rainfall series (1901–2025) via Dataful, collated from official sources

caveat: The embedded snapshot contains 2019–2023 only; it is not a ten-year state-wise rainfall series. Annual totals are taken as reported in the source table and may not exactly equal the sum of rounded displayed monthly values. Use the linked historical series portal to build a longer state/subdivision analysis and record its geographic unit carefully.

title: Station climate normals: Chennai vs Jaisalmer
description: Compare monthly normal daily minimum/maximum temperatures and average rainfall to explore coastal vs arid-climate differences.
sourceLabel: IMD City Climatological Tables — Chennai and Jaisalmer
caveat: Only two stations are included. These are 1981–2010 climate normals, not recent daily observations or current-year temperature extremes. Values follow the IMD page’s monthly climatological table.

title: Rice yield by major producing state
description: Compare rice yield over two agricultural years across major producing states and the national aggregate.
geography: Major producing states plus All India
sourceLabel: Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare — Agricultural Statistics at a Glance 2023, Table 2.4(b)
caveat: These are major producing states listed in the table, not every state/UT. Values are yields, not production tonnes or crop area.

title: Wheat yield and irrigation coverage
description: Compare yield in the 2022–23 agricultural year with reported crop irrigation coverage for 2021–22.
geography: Selected wheat-producing states plus All India
sourceLabel: Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare — Agricultural Statistics at a Glance 2023, Table 2.5(b)
caveat: The two columns refer to different agricultural years: wheat yield 2022–23 and irrigation coverage 2021–22. Coverage is not the share of all land irrigated in the state.

title: Sugarcane yield by state
description: Compare sugarcane yields for two agricultural years in selected producing states.
geography: Selected producing states plus All India
sourceLabel: Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare — Agricultural Statistics at a Glance 2023, Table 2.21(b)
caveat: Selected state rows from the published table. Yield is kilograms per hectare; it is not the same as total production.

title: Irrigation coverage and water sources
description: National-level indicators show the role of irrigated area and the relative importance of canals, tube-wells and wells.
sourceLabel: Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare — Land Use Statistics at a Glance 2022–23
caveat: This is a national aggregate, not a state-wise table. Canal/tube-well/well shares describe source composition and do not necessarily sum to 100% because other sources also exist.

Includes repeated irrigation of the same land during the year.

rows.definition: Share of total irrigated area by source.

title: Occupational structure of workers
description: Explore Census worker categories and how their distribution differs by sex and rural/urban residence.
unit: Percent of workers within each subgroup
caveat: These are worker-category shares (main + marginal workers) for 2011. “Other workers” is a broad residual category and should not be treated as an exact tertiary-sector percentage.

title: Installed electricity capacity by state/UT
description: Explore state/UT installed capacity from the Central Electricity Authority General Review, comparing year-end 2022 and 2023.
geography: State/UT figures; one All India total includes central sector
sourceLabel: Central Electricity Authority — General Review 2024, Table 3.3
caveat: This is a historical capacity snapshot, not current installed capacity. The All India figure includes Central Sector and is not directly the sum of state rows. Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh are combined in the cited table.

title: State/UT road network — reported rows
description: Compare total and surfaced road length using the MoRTH Basic Road Statistics report.
geography: 31 state/UT records from the reported table extract
sourceLabel: Ministry of Road Transport & Highways — Basic Road Statistics of India 2019–20
caveat: Only the 31 rows captured from the published state/UT table are bundled here; missing units are not assumed to be zero. This is road length, not road density: to calculate density divide road length by the state/UT area. Values are historical, not current.

title: Major mineral & energy locations — starter list
description: A selected place-name dataset for projects on coalfields, iron ore, lignite and power stations.
sourceLabel: Ministry of Coal; Indian Bureau of Mines; NTPC; NPCIL
caveat: This is a starter place list, not a full inventory and not geocoded; it is suitable for state-wise discussion but not directly for a dot map. Add verified coordinates and source each site before spatial plotting.

title: Selected cyclone landfall / impact events
description: Use the selected list to introduce coastal vulnerability, cyclone tracks and different affected coastlines.
sourceLabel: India Meteorological Department — Regional Specialised Meteorological Centre, New Delhi
caveat: This list is illustrative and not exhaustive, so it must not be used to calculate a full ten-year cyclone frequency or vulnerability score. The named IMD category and event note are different from a measured impact score.

title: Railway route-kilometres — official data source
description: Find a suitable state/UT-wise route-kilometre table from the Ministry of Railways for railway density projects.
period: Reference source; select the reporting year in the official publication
geography: India; coverage depends on the chosen official table
caveat: A harmonised state-wise numeric extract is not bundled here. Do not treat this resource directory row as a real measurement; open the official source and record the report year and boundary definitions before mapping.

rows.reference_period: Use the year shown in the selected official report
rows.availability: Official reference link; numeric table not bundled in this version

title: More official dataset portals
description: Use these official portals to download updated or more detailed tables for your project; this directory is a set of resources rather than new measured data.
caveat: This is a resource directory, not a numeric dataset. Always record the publication year, geographic boundaries and units of downloaded data.
